test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Having known that / the train was already on the platform, / they ran fastly / to catch it.

options.text: the train was already on the platform

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**fastly**" instead of the correct adverb "**fast**."
 
• The word "**fastly**" is not a proper word in English. The correct adverb form of "fast" is simply "**fast**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**they ran fast**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Having known that the train was already on the platform, they ran fast to catch it."*
